messages:
tess: quick FYI — v5-rerank onboarding: after moving to compact JSON candidate list, ndcg up ~1.8% but top-1 hit rate down ~2.3% on prod-like sample.
omar: numbers + sample?
tess: brief run (5k queries): model=v5 ptq-int8, old-format top1=0.412 new-format top1=0.403 (-2.2%), ndcg@10 0.286->0.291 (+1.7%)
julia: could be token-boundary shift -> can you share per-query token deltas?
tess: median prefix tokens increased +9 when stringifying; uploading per-query CSV now.
ci-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/v5/compact-json-top1-delta.csv
omar: proposal: add CI guardrail. On PRs that touch candidate formatting or onboarding scripts run a micro-holdout (1k queries) in fp32 & int8 and fail PR if top1 drop >1%.
julia: +1 and include a pre-tokenize parity test to separate tokenization vs model numeric effects.
tess: will draft PR and add test stub at rerank/tests/test_format_safety.py
tess: snippet to add:
```python
def test_format_top1_guard():
    # run 1k sample in fp32 and int8 for old/new formats, assert top1_delta <= 0.01
    pass
```
omar: also, interim mitigation: add an explicit short delimiter token (e.g., <DOC>) inside each JSON item to anchor token boundaries.
julia: agree — include as recommendation in onboarding doc and Optimize playbook.
ops-bot: canary paused for v5-compact-json until triage + CI PR merged.
tess: filing onboarding checklist entry + PR link when ready.
